Transport Documents

Certificado de Inspeção

An independent third-party document confirming that goods meet contractual specifications in quality, quantity, or condition before shipment or upon arrival.

Quick answer: An independent third-party document confirming that goods meet contractual specifications in quality, quantity, or condition before shipment or upon arrival.

Quick answer

An independent third-party document confirming that goods meet contractual specifications in quality, quantity, or condition before shipment or upon arrival.

Why it matters

Certificado de Inspeção matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Certificado de Inspeção?

In this glossary, Certificado de Inspeção refers to: An independent third-party document confirming that goods meet contractual specifications in quality, quantity, or condition before shipment or upon arrival.

How is Certificado de Inspeção used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Um certificado de inspeção emitido pela SGS era exigido antes da liberação do embarque de máquinas ao importador."

Why does Certificado de Inspeção matter in logistics?

Certificado de Inspeção matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Certificado de Inspeção?

Certificado de Inspeção is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Certificado de Inspeção belong to?

In this glossary, Certificado de Inspeção is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

An independent third-party document confirming that goods meet contractual specifications in quality, quantity, or condition before shipment or upon arrival.

Operational example

An inspection certificate issued by SGS was required before releasing the machinery shipment to the importer.

Localized term

Certificado de Inspeção

Localized example

Um certificado de inspeção emitido pela SGS era exigido antes da liberação do embarque de máquinas ao importador.
